sources.title: Ministry of Tourism, Creative Economy and Culture (Grenada): About Culture (reached from motcec.gov.gd/?p=3794)
sources.said: The Division of Culture works with stakeholders to enhance the cultural offering through technical support for the performing arts, training for festival organizers, and facilitating the processes to preserve natural heritage assets. HOW WE SERVE Policy development and implementation Technical support for performing arts, music, theatre and dance, including capacity building for teachers Training for festival organizers Preservation of national heritage assets … Other projects: Formation of the National Performing Company

figures.finding: No source on this was found by the earlier markets research and none was sought today; recorded as not modeled, not as absent. The Division of Culture's page lists technical support, not grants. The page lists projects, not a production fund. An absence only for what that page covers. No theatre call was found.
